**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent)**

The Agreement contains no vendor insurance obligation. The only occurrence of "insurance" is in the fees clause (p0051), where it is a cost Licensee pays. General Provisions (p0144–p0159) covers governing law through representation by counsel and then goes straight to the signature block.

Because Licensor hosts the trading platform and processes our data, no coverage at all sits below the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and near walk-away. I validated and submitted a preferred-position insert as new subsection (l) after p0159: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Licensor processes our data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request, with a term-plus-one-year maintenance period.
